highlight.$description: Highlight (marked text). Component tokens reference semantic tokens; a literal here is a decision this component owns, and the description is why.

corner.$description: Corner is em-relative on purpose: a highlight sits inline and must scale with the text it marks, which a rem or px corner would not.

background.$description: A Qeet tint, not highlighter yellow: a match is the brand's emphasis role, quieter than a selection. Translucent on purpose, so it composes over whatever row it sits in — a hovered list item, a selected (brand-subtle) result — and stays visible on each, in both themes, from one value. Deliberately not the ::selection colour, so a match never reads as selected text.

foreground.$description: Matched text is lifted to primary text even inside muted copy (a result's subtitle), so the match is carried by contrast and weight as well as by the tint — colour is never the only signal.

padding-inline.$description: Breathing room for the tint, em-relative like the corner. Cancelled by an equal negative margin, so marking text never moves it: results do not jitter sideways as a query is typed.
